title: O-Researcher-SFT/O-Researcher-RL

defines.name: O-Researcher
defines.definition: A multi-agent framework that automatically synthesizes research-grade instructional data and trains open-source LLMs with a two-stage SFT and RL strategy.

problem: Open-source LLMs lag behind closed-source models because they lack access to high-quality training data for complex reasoning tasks.
